turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen says he got a zero without anyone calling me.
Can I ask something off the record?
There's no off the record. Who decided on the zero?
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went in?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar, Hale, or just negligent?
